patterns.note: Asymmetrical hero layout with large, impactful typography on the left and a dynamic visual element (video/image) on the right.
Extremely large, bold sans-serif headings are used for primary messaging, creating a strong visual hierarchy and modern feel.
Predominantly white and light gray backgrounds are contrasted with dark text and strategic, vibrant accents derived from the eBay brand palette.

The hero section features a scroll-triggered content transformation where the main heading text changes and a new interactive carousel of design system elements (Logo, Color, Typography, Photography) is revealed as the user scrolls down.
Content is organized into distinct, full-width sections with generous vertical padding, often using alternating light background shades to delineate them.

technique_notes: The hero section employs a scroll-triggered animation system (likely using a JavaScript library like GSAP ScrollTrigger) to dynamically swap out the main heading text and reveal a new interactive content block (a carousel) as the user scrolls past a certain point. The header navigation remains sticky throughout the scroll.
Visual content is presented in a mix of full-bleed imagery and structured card-like grids, often with a clean, minimal aesthetic and ample whitespace to emphasize key elements.
Interactive elements like carousels and image galleries are used to showcase different aspects of the design system, providing dynamic content within a clean layout.

design_tokens.type_scale: Massive, extra-bold sans-serif headings (~5-6x body text) create a dominant visual statement, complemented by clean, legible body text and smaller uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners are consistently applied to cards, buttons, and image containers, contributing to a soft, modern feel.
design_tokens.spacing: An airy and balanced density, with very generous vertical spacing in the hero and between major sections, transitioning to a more balanced grid density for feature displays.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the dynamic, scroll-triggered hero transformation, where the primary message and content entirely change as the user scrolls, creating an engaging and surprising reveal of the site's core offerings. This goes beyond simple parallax or fade-ins, offering a true content swap.
